summary: v80 public pricing page (fee types show_on_pricing) and Bid Challenge module tested end to end: backend pytest (14/14 pass, run serially with -n 0) plus Playwright UI for admin Fee types, /pricing logged out and at mobile width, vendor debrief challenge panel (lodge + appeal), staff committee voting tab, and admin /admin/e/challenges (standstill corrigendum, meeting with past/future date, resolution confirm_award, appeal dismiss). All requested flows work. One privacy bug: the vendor view of a challenge leaks committee member emails and other bidders' emails through meeting.attendees and meeting.scheduled_by. Demo data was restored afterwards.

critical.issue: _out(vendor_view=True) only removes votes and appeal_decided_by. Once a meeting is scheduled, the vendor response includes meeting.attendees, which lists committee1/committee2 emails plus every other bidder's email (e.g. northfield, the awarded competitor), and meeting.scheduled_by, a committee email. resolution.by (admin email) is also exposed. This breaks the 'vendor view must not expose committee member emails' requirement and leaks competitor contacts. Fix: in vendor view keep only meeting.scheduled_at/location (maybe attendee count) and strip resolution.by.

minor.issue: The issuer is never invited for demo tenders because the notices have no created_by or created_by_email (0 of 5 notices in the preview DB have them). DEMO-TND-AWD attendees = 2 committee + 2 bidders only. Vendor-built tenders may store the issuer under a different field, so check that.
Any committee_member can schedule a meeting, even one not on this tender's committee (no _members check, unlike vote).
A committee_member sees every tender's challenges and vendor emails, not only the tenders whose committee they sit on.
Emails are sent one after another inside the request. The resolution POST took more than 2.5s with 4 attendees, so the UI refresh was late. Consider BackgroundTasks.

After a challenge is closed or resolved, the same bidder can lodge another one during the standstill (only one open at a time is enforced), but the vendor copy says 'you can lodge one formal challenge'. Align the copy or the rule.

ui_bugs.issue: The Outcome/resolution form (resolution-confirm_award / resolution-re_evaluate) shows for any viewer once meeting_scheduled and the meeting time has passed, including committee_member staff in /staff. The backend returns 403 for them (admin only). Hide it when staff=true.

issues: The global mobile app header and the page's own 'PMC Managers' header both show, so the brand appears twice
No footer on the pricing page
Gold uppercase subtitle (brand-gold on cream) has low contrast
meeting-at uses the native datetime-local picker, not a shadcn date/time picker; the value is read in browser local time but shown as UTC
The intro text hardcodes '10 days' even when the tender's standstill was changed

action_items: Strip meeting.attendees, meeting.scheduled_by and resolution.by from the vendor view in bid_challenges._out(vendor_view=True)
Hide the resolution Outcome form in ChallengesBody when staff=true (or when the user is not admin)
Include the tender issuer in the meeting attendees: check which field holds the issuer on demo and vendor-built notices
Restrict schedule_meeting and the list endpoint to the tender's committee members (or admin)
Optional: send challenge emails in the background; align the 'one formal challenge' copy with the backend rule
critical_code_review_comments: bid_challenges._out vendor_view leaks PII (see backend critical)
standstill() uses find_one for the awarded bid; multi-lot tenders with several awarded bids would pick an arbitrary one
lodge_challenge builds challenge_ref from count_documents, so two simultaneous lodges can get the same ref (no unique index)
public_pricing filters emd_masters on is_active True; rules missing the is_active field are silently hidden (all current rules have it)

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14), plus 1 HIGH privacy bug found by a leak probe
success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all flows work; 1 staff UI role bug)

seed_data_creation: None kept. All bid_challenges and standstill corrigenda on DEMO-TND-AWD were deleted. The notice's standstill_days, award_suspended and re_evaluation_required were unset. The northfield bid was restored to status awarded with awarded_at 2026-11-01T02:21:14.711079+00:00. The registration fee type's show_on_pricing was set back to false.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_v80_bid_challenges_pricing.py -n 0 (must be serial because the tests share state on the demo tender). The module teardown restores the demo data; tests/_v80_restore.py restores it manually and tests/_v80_inspect.py prints the state. Unified login is /login?next=... with signin-role-{admin|staff|supplier}, signin-e-email, signin-e-password, signin-e-submit. Committee staff log in with active_role committee_member. Preview clock is about 2026-11-02, so the DEMO-TND-AWD standstill is running until 2026-11-11. test_04_vendor_view_leak prints the leak but does not assert; turn it into an assert once fixed.
